name: omp-claudecode-port-project
description: Context-efficiency tricks ported from oh-my-pi: rules that stay dormant until you go off-script, and reads that return signatures instead of whole files. Hooks are installed by install.sh; this manifest provides the skills.
//: No hooks block on purpose. The hooks are a compiled binary that has to be built first, so they cannot be registered by a manifest that ships source only - a manifest-registered hook would point at a binary that may not exist. Run install.sh, which builds it and registers absolute paths. An earlier version of this file registered the JS hooks under node; that shipped the exact interpreter this project removed.
